counter_definitions.historical_phase29_raw_VAL808_image_read: Every raw VAL808 image physically opened at any point during Phase 29. This is 808 and is REAL. It must never again be represented as zero.
counter_definitions.noncanonical_pre_reconciliation_VAL808_i: The subset of historical reads attributable to the noncanonical pre-reconciliation cache build under superseded no-autocast semantics. Also 808.
counter_definitions.new_VAL808_image_reads_during_preexecuti: Raw VAL808 images opened during this Phase-D pre-execution reconciliation. Zero.
counter_definitions.canonical_phase_d_VAL808_image_reads_bef: Raw VAL808 images opened under canonical Phase27 autocast-fp16 semantics before authorized Phase-D execution. Zero.

required_statements.historical_808_reads_are_real: The historical Phase29 raw VAL808 image reads number 808 and are real. They must never again be represented as zero.
required_statements.historical_reads_not_canonical_phase_d_e: The 808 historical reads do NOT constitute canonical Phase-D scientific extraction, because the corresponding cache was generated under SUPERSEDED numerical semantics (FP32 / inference_mode / no autocast) that contradict the frozen Phase27 autocast-fp16 contract.
required_statements.noncanonical_cache_disposition: The noncanonical cache remains preserved as evidence but is scientifically NON-REUSABLE.
required_statements.unqualified_zero_counter_forbidden: 'VAL808_reads = 0' is FORBIDDEN as an unqualified counter from this point onward.
required_statements.zero_counters_must_be_scoped: Any zero VAL808 counter must name its exact scope.
